uncertainty: Two reverse-order run pairs on an already-seen workload. Expected endpoint differences can be below run drift; no repeated-until-significant rule, no request-level pseudo-replication. Full result or an uncertain/no-service-value result must be retained.
controls: Same normal arrival stream, prompts, fixed output counts, model/precision/GPU/Host/KV/native scheduler/decode/recovery/operators. Both formal arms pay snapshot/observation cost; no online rollout cost is claimed.
exceptional_behavior: Unsupported full-allocation domain consumes the opportunity and stays1024. Missing head/observed first output/4-decision limit ends intervention. Native/forward errors retain raw; zero actual P>1024 in first X stops group before reverse pair, no retry.

decision: Report complete U numerator/denominator, all-request TTFT/generation/flow/maxgap/drain and output divergence, actual steps and prefix mismatch. No new qualified requests and tiny elapsed effect do not establish dynamic need. One-sign/numerical drift remains uncertain without automatic additional repeats.
